service_missing.description: Exit-only: the operator manifest is not served (404). Code deployment_manifest_unavailable.

service.message: Withdrawals work, but new deposits and private chats wait until the operator’s deployment manifest is served and matches this build again.

service_changed.description: Exit-only: the served manifest changed a pinned key. Code deployment_manifest_mismatch.

service.message: Withdrawals work, but new deposits and private chats wait until the operator’s deployment manifest is served and matches this build again.
service.detail: The deployment manifest changed its pinned state_signing_key.x.

service_legacy.description: Exit-only: the served manifest is the legacy circuit. Code incompatible_proof_circuit, with status 503 and exits true on an attempt.

service.message: Withdrawals work, but new deposits and private chats wait until the operator’s deployment manifest is served and matches this build again.
service.detail: This deployment uses an incompatible legacy proof circuit. Funding is unavailable until the operator publishes a new vault and concession-exit proof setup. Keep existing funds and recovery data with the legacy deployment.

kit_never_exported.description: A healthy note whose exit kit was never exported (exported_seq null, state_seq 1).

kit_out_of_date.description: A kit exported at state 1 while the note advanced to state 3.

near_expiry.description: One minute inside the near-expiry threshold (expiry minus must_initiate_by margin minus window minus 4,500 s).

just_outside_near_expiry.description: One hour outside the near-expiry threshold.

unresolved_request_settlement_wait.description: A transmitted request the server reserved but did not settle: state_fresh false, an escape_at, a bound.

mutual_lock_with_ownership_proof.description: A mutual close in progress: the exit lock holds a released ownership proof.

escape_lock_released_proof.description: An escape in progress: a released kind-0 proof freezes the note until it expires.

device_not_newest_evidence.description: Finalized defeat evidence at the current state: another device spent its successor.

withdrawals_alert_credited_defeated.description: No slot note; own records: an alerted close, a credited payout (receipt evidence), a credited payout (vault credit, amount unknown), a claimed credit, a defeated restored escape and a set-aside note near its deadline.

withdrawals.error: The escape was defeated: another device spent this balance’s next state, so this device is not the newest. Restore the newest backup or exit kit.

other_deployments.description: Empty slot; records of two other deployments: an open escape, a credit still awaiting finality (in both lists) and a settled credit.

service_unavailable.producedBy: runtime.assertServiceAvailable() with the manifest served as 404
service_unavailable.name: BrowserWalletHttpError
service_unavailable.message: Withdrawals work, but new deposits and private chats wait until the operator’s deployment manifest is served and matches this build again. Unable to load https://zkapi-v2c-mainnet.example.test/config.json (404).

service_mismatch.name: BrowserWalletHttpError
service_mismatch.message: Withdrawals work, but new deposits and private chats wait until the operator’s deployment manifest is served and matches this build again. The deployment manifest changed its pinned state_signing_key.x.

service_incompatible.producedBy: runtime.assertServiceAvailable() with the legacy circuit served
service_incompatible.name: BrowserWalletHttpError
service_incompatible.message: Withdrawals work, but new deposits and private chats wait until the operator’s deployment manifest is served and matches this build again. This deployment uses an incompatible legacy proof circuit. Funding is unavailable until the operator publishes a new vault and concession-exit proof setup. Keep existing funds and recovery data with the legacy deployment.

native_vault_unverified.producedBy: runtime.assertServiceAvailable() while the pinned RPC cannot confirm the vault
native_vault_unverified.name: BrowserWalletHttpError
native_vault_unverified.message: The pinned vault does not accept native ETH in the configured denomination.

note_near_expiry.name: BrowserWalletHttpError
note_near_expiry.message: This balance is too close to its expiry for a new private chat: a chat now could still be settling when the balance must be withdrawn. Withdraw it instead.

exit_locked.producedBy: runtime.prepareLeaseRequest() while an exit proof is live
exit_locked.name: BrowserWalletHttpError
exit_locked.message: A withdrawal of this balance is in progress, so no new private chat can start from it. Finish the withdrawal, or cancel it; a released exit proof keeps the balance frozen until it expires.

request_settlement_pending_chat.producedBy: runtime.assertAnchorAcceptsRequest(state) with a reserved request archived
request_settlement_pending_chat.name: BrowserWalletHttpError
request_settlement_pending_chat.message: The server is still settling an earlier private request for this balance. Try again after it settles.

request_settlement_pending_withdraw.producedBy: runtime.prepareWithdrawal(mutual) with an unresolved request at the state
request_settlement_pending_withdraw.name: BrowserWalletHttpError
request_settlement_pending_withdraw.message: The server may still settle a private request sent from this balance. A mutual close waits for it; an escape is available now (conceding nothing by default) and concedes at most the request’s bound from the time shown.

device_not_newest_defeated.producedBy: runtime.prepareWithdrawal(mutual) at a state with defeat evidence
device_not_newest_defeated.name: BrowserWalletHttpError
device_not_newest_defeated.message: Another device spent this balance’s next state, so this device is not the newest. Restore the newest backup or exit kit before withdrawing.

device_not_newest_successor.name: BrowserWalletHttpError
device_not_newest_successor.message: Another device spent this balance’s next state, so this device is not the newest. Restore the newest backup or exit kit before withdrawing.

ownership_proof_wait.producedBy: runtime.prepareWithdrawal(mutual) with a kept ownership proof about to expire
ownership_proof_wait.name: BrowserWalletHttpError
ownership_proof_wait.message: This balance’s ownership proof expires in a few seconds. Try again then.

exit_release_pending.producedBy: runtime.prepareWithdrawal(mutual) with a dead lock and a late successor at its state
exit_release_pending.name: BrowserWalletHttpError
exit_release_pending.message: An earlier exit proof of this balance has expired, and a newer balance state is waiting until the vault confirms that the proof can no longer land. The vault’s record of this balance could not be confirmed yet. Try again shortly, or set your own exit RPC. Close to the balance’s exit deadline the exit goes ahead from the earlier state, conceding at most its last chat’s budget.

legacy_incompatible_proof_circuit.name: Error
legacy_incompatible_proof_circuit.message: This deployment uses an incompatible legacy proof circuit. Funding is unavailable until the operator publishes a new vault and note-bound proof setup. Keep existing funds and recovery data with the legacy deployment.
